newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Devex says no to gold mine purchase.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Devex says no to gold mine purchase.

text.p: Miner Devex Ltd said on Monday it will not proceed with the acquisition of a 51 percent interest in the Norton goldfields, located 300 km north of Gympie in Queensland.
"It just wasn't big enough to warrant our involvement," Devex managing director Harry Adams told Reuters.
No financial exposure had been incurred, Adams said.
Devex last December said it would take up the stake and was planning to start trial mining and processing at Norton early in 1997.
The field had previously reported open pittable mineral resources to a depth of 25 metres of 55,000 tonnes of ore 6.30 grams of gold a tonne.
